prompt: A watercolor illustration captures the vibrant energy of a beach volleyball tournament under a bright sky. On the left, a woman in a blue bikini jumps high to spike the ball, her arm extended upward. Next to her stands a referee in a striped shirt, holding a whistle to his lips while looking at the net. The white net stretches across the center, slightly sagging under tension. On the right side of the court, a man in red shorts dives low, his hand reaching for the sand. Behind him, a spectator in a yellow hat points toward the action with excitement. Sitting on a cooler nearby is a girl in a pink dress, watching intently. A brown dog lies next to her, resting its head on its paws. In the foreground, a boy in green trunks holds a large beach ball, standing beside a woman in a sun hat who is handing him a bottle of water. Further back, an old man in a grey coat leans on a cane, observing the game. A young couple shares an umbrella; the man wears sunglasses and the woman has long braids. They stand near a stack of towels. A seagull flies above the scene, wings spread wide. There is no snow on the ground. There is no basketball hoop visible.
